title: Pocket notes for growth & triage — Riley ⇢ Ioana
content:
Context: quick pocket prep before my 1:1 with Ioana. Goal: align on next quarter priorities, unblock infra work, and surface career signals. Keep this informal — notes to self and prompts to bring up.

Background bullets (two-line refresh):
- Ioana: IC3 -> IC4 trajectory; strong on model optimization research but recent transit into infra ownership (kv cache integration). Wants clearer path to tech lead.
- Current work: shipping kv-cache v2 (stability), batching improvements for short-sequence latency, review of PR #987 (perf regression in p99 path).
- Recent signals: high quality design docs, but slower PR throughput due to context-switching across infra & eval tasks.

Meeting objectives (top 3):
1) Decide minimal scope to finish kv-cache v2 and a rollback/fallback plan if rollout causes perf variance.
2) Calibration on career steps: what specific outcomes (projects, mentoring, docs) map to IC4 at Redwood.
3) Identify 2 concrete unblockers (infra tickets, access, pairing sessions) and owners with timelines.

Micro-agenda (30–40m):
- 0–5m: personal check-in (how are you? energy load?) — quick human first.
- 5–15m: status on kv-cache v2 + PR #987 specifics (what slipped, why p99 regressions surfaced).
- 15–25m: career thread (what does IC4 look like for you; what small wins this quarter).
- 25–35m: blockers / action items (triage infra tickets, pairing, docs).
- 35–40m: confirm next steps, calendar invites for pairing/archival doc owners.

Questions / prompts I want to ask (shorthand):
- "What part of kv-cache v2 keeps you up at night?" (forces specifics: tests, perf, edge cases)
- "If you could take one thing off your plate, what would it be?" (identify delegatable work)
- "What would a manager or peer need to see in the next 6 weeks to be confident you belong at IC4?" (evidence-focused)
- "Who would you like to mentor or pair with to build leadership signals?"

Technical dive notes (for my reading):
- PR #987: regression appears only when seq_len<16 under burst mode; hypothesize scheduling bug in batching window. Check scheduler config + continuous-batching timeouts.
- Quick tests to run: reproduce locally with short-seq harness (script: tools/harness/short_seq_test.sh), add explicit trace logs at batch boundary.
- If can't fix in 3 days: plan to gate rollout by region + add canary with 10% traffic; fallback to v1 path on p99>target.

Career calibration checklist (IC4 signals):
- Repeated ownership: led at least one cross-team rollout end-to-end (design → rollout → fallout handling).
- Mentorship: regular pairing with at least 1 junior engineer and written feedback.
- Design artifacts: authored a public design doc with architecture decisions & tradeoffs that was adopted.
- Operational excellence: demonstrates incident postmortem ownership once across a major outage.

Concrete action items (A = action):
- A1: Riley -> draft short gating plan for kv-cache v2 (canary criteria, rollback steps) by 2026-08-07. (Riley)
- A2: Ioana -> add reproducible short-seq test case and attach logs to PR #987 by 2026-08-06. (Ioana)
- A3: Maya -> block time for 2x 1-hour pairing sessions next week to land batching fix (Maya) — I'll set invites. (Riley)
- A4: Ioana -> write 1-page IC4 goals doc (success criteria + projects) and share before next 1:1 (2026-08-18). (Ioana)
- A5: Riley -> connect Ioana to platform-ops and request KMS access audit for Canary infra (ticket INF-1023) by 2026-08-09. (Riley)

Manager private notes (do not send):
- Watch for signs of stretched bandwidth — she's covering infra + eval + mentoring. Consider carving out 20% protected focus for deep work (label as "project sprint") next sprint.
- Candidate for a small leadership stretch: ask to lead a 2-week cross-functional spike with PM & SRE; outcome should be a proposed rollout plan and a short public doc.
- Praise to give next time: highlight design clarity and ownership of regression triage. Be specific: reference the new test harness and the gating criteria.

Risks / open questions: 
- If batching scheduler fix requires kernel change, timeline may slip beyond quarter. Contingency: prioritize fallback path and tighten canary thresholds.
- Are we hamstrung by infra capacity in eu-west? Check with infra team on reserved GPU pool usage (if >80% need to request burst).

Notes to add to calendar invite (for Ioana):
- "Quick sync: kv-cache v2 status, unblockers, IC4 calibration. Will ask for a brief 1-page goals doc by next 1:1. Bring any failing test logs."

Rough script lines (sounding board):
- "I want to understand the smallest possible ship that reduces risk while keeping your ownership signal strong."
- "What do you need from me to make room for deep work next sprint?"
- "If we set a measurable canary (p99 < X ms across region), how quickly can you add the guard rails?"

End of pocket notes. Will tidy into a short calendar agenda before the meeting and paste a trimmed version to the invite.

---
Version history: quick draft. Save as "pocket" so I can iterate.
